entries.title: Radio Tower in a Storm of Noise
entries.description: A central vertical antenna emits expanding translucent wave shells (signal) that propagate through a space filled with drifting metallic spheres of random sizes (noise) that scatter, absorb, or distort the waves, with color-coded regions showing strong vs weak reception.

entries.title: Optical Fiber with Signal Pulses and Scattering Defects
entries.description: A long transparent cylinder (fiber) carries bright, labeled light pulses that travel down its length while tiny embedded particles cause some pulses to scatter, dim, split, or reflect, with an external bar graph showing signal-to-noise ratio over time.

entries.title: Neural Network with Clean and Noisy Activations
entries.description: Layers of spheres (neurons) connected by thin cylinders (synapses) light up as colored pulses travel through, where some pulses are clear (green) and others corrupted (red noise), with nodes that can amplify, filter, or block signals and a floating meter that tracks network accuracy.

entries.title: Underwater Sonar Pings and Schooling Fish Noise
entries.description: A submarine sphere at one end of a clear blue volume sends out circular sonar wavefronts while schools of reflective fish-like objects swim, bounce, and cluster, reflecting and distorting the waves so that returning echoes are a mix of strong target signals and noisy clutter.

entries.title: Cell Signaling in a Crowded Cytoplasm

entries.title: Satellite Communication Through Space Debris
entries.description: A satellite dish on a small rotating satellite sends narrow signal beams toward a ground station while a cloud of tumbling debris cubes and dust particles orbits between them, intermittently blocking, reflecting, or scattering the beam, with signal strength displayed as a color-changing bar.

entries.title: Crowded Room Conversation vs Background Chatter
entries.description: Simple humanoid figures stand and move in a bright room, with one pair exchanging distinct glowing speech bubbles (signal) that travel between them while other figures emit faint, overlapping, semi-transparent bubbles (noise) that can collide, merge, and obscure the main conversation.

entries.title: Digital Data Stream with Bit Errors
